test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 3rd December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What will be the difference in the simple interest and compound interest compounded annually on a sum of Rs. 6,000 in 2 years at the interest rate of 5% per annum?
solution:
Given:

Principal = Rs. 6000

Rate of interest = 5% & Time = 2 years

Concept used:

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI

where,

P = Principal amount & R = Rate of interest per year

T = Time in years

In case of the compound interest,

Amount = P(1 + R/100)N</p&g
